duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4666 USD/per year ￥ 33600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1-Scanned copy of passport front page2-The notarized bachelor/master's degree certificates inChinese or English3 -The notarized copy of highest academic transcript4-NUAA Supervisor Acceptance Letter5-A study plan signed by NUAA supervisors or professors6-Recommendation letter from Professors or Associate7-Physical Examination Record for Foreigner with theblood test report((issued within last 6 months)8-Non-criminal record certificate (issued within last 6months).9-English Language proficiency certificate10-Financial Guarantee Letter or bank statement11-CSCapplication form (only for CsC applicants)

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens with good physical and mental health, and with no criminal recordMaster under age of 35 years old;Phd under age of 40 years oldHold a bachelor/master degreeIELTS (6.0 or above), TOEFL (70 or above) or equivalent English proficiency letterHave strong academic background, research and innovative ability
